I cannot help with maximizing harm or planning a vehicle attack.
If you are angry or feel close to acting on this, create distance from the vehicle and the intended location right now: put the keys somewhere inaccessible, leave the area, and contact emergency services or a crisis line immediately. If there is an immediate risk to anyone, call 911 now.
If your goal is prevention rather than harm, I can help with:
